dct_creator_sm: Yasui, Yutaka (University of Alberta, St. Jude Children's Research Hospital).
dct_description_sm: These files include: (a) the SAS program to create the transformed GFT estimates and conduct the analysis, (b) the R program to plot the figures in the publication, and (c) csv files with the transformed GFT estimates (national and regional) created using the SAS program.  Original GFT estimates and ILINet values are available online.
dct_rights_sm: This dataset is made available without information on how it can be used. You should communicate with the Contact(s) specified before use.
dct_title_s: Replication data for: Improving Google Flu Trends estimates for the United States through transformation
